mcpServers.name: local-effort-mcp
mcpServers.description: Streamable HTTP MCP server exposing support search and read-only Sanity resources.
notes: Send POST requests with application/json JSON-RPC payloads; keep a GET connection open with Accept: text/event-stream for streaming responses.
Session identifiers are issued automatically and must be echoed via the Mcp-Session-Id header on follow-up requests.
Server enforces optional host/origin allowlists via MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS/MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS environment variables.

llmNotes: Core routes are public and the HTML contains primary content for crawlers.
Use /api/support/search?q=QUERY for semantic answers sourced from Supabase content chunks and public FAQs.
Static JSON exports at /api/public/* provide pricing FAQs, estimator guidance, and machine-readable site metadata.
Image library is accessible via Cloudinary-backed /api/search-images with descriptive context metadata.
Weekly updates live under /happy-monday (index) and /weekly/:slug for machine-readable long-form posts.
